item.title: Show HN: Streambench – Native Mac Client for Kafka and NATS
item.summary: When building Hookie, I worked with NATS Jetstream a lot. While you can do everything using the CLI, I prefer the feeling of a nice GUI better. So I built one. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49303545 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
